_note: What it takes to be hired into each role, beyond skills (DECISIONS #43). 'usual' comes from the role's MASCO 2020 major group and is what employers usually ask for, not a rule: MASCO itself says the skills may also come from informal training and experience. 'licence' is a legal or official requirement to do the work; a role with one is never shown as a short next move unless it is the person's own job. Sources checked 22 Oct 2026; team: confirm each and fill reviewed_by (REVIEW_LOG.md).
